overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation by the Becket Board of Selectmen. The district warrant meeting is governed by enabling legislation, not the OML, and a single selectman's action did not involve a quorum.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a warrant meeting of the Sherwood Forest Lake District was moved to a different location without proper notice.
allegations.key_passage: The District is not a public body subject to the G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a single selectman acted alone in representing the town at the initial district meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Although you state that a single Selectman does not have authority to represent the town, it appears in this case that a single member of the Board may represent the town in the narrow circumstance of calling the initial meeting of the Lake District, according to Chapter 107 of the Acts of 2010.
